target.role: Manager / Senior Manager, Quantitative Market Risk Models – Financial Engineering and Modeling

summary: Manager / Senior Manager, Quantitative Market Risk Models – Financial Engineering and Modeling candidate with ~7 years across quantitative model validation, derivatives pricing review, and model governance at Moody's Analytics, EY, and Ortec Finance. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement). Hands-on with stochastic scenario generation, Monte Carlo simulation, and Python analytics. CFA charterholder with dual MSc (Financial Modelling; Chemical Engineering — PDE and numerical-methods foundation); applied working knowledge of VaR/CVaR; familiar with FRTB and CCAR frameworks through client-advisory context, not direct trading-book capital submission.
core_skills: Monte Carlo Simulation & Stochastic Scenario Generation
Interest Rate Risk Analytics (Parallel & Non-Parallel Shocks)

roles.title: Asst. Director – Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Derivatives Pricing Review & Quantitative Model Validation
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement (cumulatively ~$50bn+); independently reviews curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation — reviews sensitivity consistency and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates; escalates outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.
Reviews interest rate risk and duration analytics under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks; applies quantitative methodologies analogous to sensitivities-based market-risk frameworks.

sections.heading: Model Governance, Documentation & Stakeholder Communication
bullets: Operates within a formal model-governance framework — reviews assumptions, validates economic defensibility, and documents to standards consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.
Serves as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders at Canadian and U.S. institutional clients.
Prepares quantitative summaries for senior stakeholders on interest rate exposure, scenario impacts, and sensitivity behaviour; translates model outputs into committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Quantitative Model Development & Python Tooling
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — embedding behavioral assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded validation, logging, and version control.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reducing development cycle time by an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.

roles.title: Client Service Specialist – PFaroe Analytics Platform

bullets: Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; advised on asset, liability, and risk-model configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.

Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM, translating client investment-team requirements into structured Product Owner development requests.

roles.title: Senior Consultant – IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 model and technology transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and implementation materials.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators using Monte Carlo simulation to assess interest rate, inflation, FX, and equity risk under base-case and stressed environments for pension and institutional clients.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk attribution, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.

Modelled fixed-income and derivatives positions alongside actuarial liabilities; performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Presented quantitative findings — including duration, currency, inflation, and leverage-overlay strategies — to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) – Western University, 2016
